description: Selected third 13-class P39 wrapper registration/control handoff after the third finite synthetic thinning, statistics, and GM-enabled membership pass.

input_materialization.membership_state: Output of the Java-matched third-thinning -> statistics -> GM-enabled membership pass, rebuilt and asserted in the focused test.
input_materialization.synthetic_fixed_point_note: The 13 membership channels equal the previous synthetic pass bit-for-bit; this is a finite fixed-point case, not evidence of membership change.
input_materialization.geometry: 17x17x17 identity affine in RAS, matching the other finite 13-class synthetic fixtures.

source_call_order: registerShapes using unchanged atlas-space priors and the prior transform

registration.initial_transform: The transform returned by the second selected synthetic registerShapes call.
reference_fields: initial energy, gradient, and diagonal Hessian
every candidate transform, source acceptance/rejection, energy and optimizer iteration value
final transform, rotation, and per-class bounds

control.expected: nonterminal no-stop decision; selected standard mode enters propagateGrowing and refreshes relations

java_reference.kind: Hand-coded selected Java formula excerpts using the pinned upstream ParametricTransform, RotationMatrix, ImageFunctions, Numerics and wrapper control sources; not execution of the full wrapper/class.

scope_limitations: The reference covers this finite third registration trace and one wrapper decision only; no later thinning/statistics/membership pass is included here.
Membership channels are at a synthetic fixed point relative to the previous 13-class pass, so this fixture does not demonstrate changing memberships.
The Java references are selected formula excerpts, not execution of the complete wrapper or LesionTOADS class, and this is not full LesionTOADS equivalence.
No real atlas or patient imaging is represented.
